raw_description:
Intraday Agent is an autonomous AI agent that helps manage intraday operational scenarios. The following are its high‑level capabilities.

Intraday queue tracking

  • Continuously monitors queue volumes in real time.
  • Detects anomalies when actual volume deviates significantly from forecasted demand.
  • Automatically reforecasts in real time to assess current demand.
  • Notifies supervisors with proactive alerts and recommendations.
  • Automates corrective actions such as adjusting schedules, rescheduling breaks, or reallocating service representatives to maintain SLA performance.
  • Supports customizable instructions to align mitigation actions with business needs.

Intraday adherence tracking

  • Monitors service representative adherence to scheduled shift activities in real time.
  • Detects deviations such as late logins, extended breaks, or early logouts.
  • Autonomously mitigates deviations through actions such as break rescheduling, shift extensions, overtime activation, or flexible channel reassignment.
  • Supports customizable instructions to align mitigation actions with business needs.
title: Dynamics 365 Customer Service: Manage intraday operations with AI agent
